summary: Backend-only testing for StartupPath landing site. All 16 pytest cases passed (root, webinar register/list, mentorship request/list, auth /me with no cookie/invalid token/seeded session via header & cookie, logout flow). Validated MongoDB persistence, _id exclusion, 422 on invalid email, Hindi confirmation message for mentorship.

minor.issue: Returns 200 even when no token is supplied. Acceptable behavior but consider 204/idempotent semantics.
Sets cookie with samesite='none' and secure=True — only works over HTTPS. Fine for prod preview URL but will silently fail on http localhost.
List endpoints are PUBLIC (no auth). Anyone can read all leads/PII. Should be admin-protected.

action_items: Consider gating /api/webinar/registrations and /api/mentorship/requests behind auth/admin role - currently exposes lead PII publicly.
Consider rate-limiting public POST endpoints (webinar/register, mentorship/request) to prevent abuse.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/webinar/registrations and /api/mentorship/requests have no authentication — leaks PII (full_name, email, phone, college). HIGH priority.
server.py: No rate limit / captcha on public POST endpoints; vulnerable to spam.
server.py: cookie flags (secure=True, samesite='none') are correct for cross-site preview URL but tied to HTTPS only — document this.
server.py: created_at stored as ISO string in some collections and as datetime in user_sessions — inconsistent. Stick to one (preferably datetime UTC).
server.py uses os.environ['MONGO_URL'] — good (fail-fast). _id is correctly excluded everywhere via projection {'_id': 0}.
Single-file server.py is small (~196 lines) so splitting not yet necessary.
test_credentials: None required. Auth tests seed user+session directly into MongoDB (test_database.users / user_sessions) per /app/auth_testing.md.
seed_data_creation: Tests create temporary users, sessions, webinar regs and mentorship requests prefixed TEST_ and clean up after the run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py covers all current backend endpoints. Fixtures auto-seed/clean MongoDB (test_database). Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py -v. JUnit XML at /app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. Frontend untested.
